module: Flowgraph node "Traffic Parameters" (once_instant). Sets the traffic system via gameplay_traffic.setTrafficVars: aiMode (traffic, random, flee, chase, follow, stop; default traffic), spawnRate (spawnValue, 0 to 3), directionBias (spawnDirBias, -1 to 1; -1 = away from the player), risk (baseAggression), poolActiveAmount (activeAmount; with data.usePoolInactiveAmount, equals the number of traffic vehicles minus the value), enableRandomEvents. Only non-nil pins are applied. Legacy pin poolAmount renamed poolActiveAmount.

init.desc: Initializes the node's internal state at creation (called by the flowgraph engine).

postInit.desc: Defines the preset values of the aiMode pin.

workOnce.desc: Builds the variables table from the non-nil pins and calls gameplay_traffic.setTrafficVars.
